description: Library Maintenance's page in jellyfin-web's TV layout as admin. From every tab, OK opens it and the D-pad's Down lands in its panel (Rebuild on Duplicates, Find duplicate movies' switch on Settings, Refresh on Diagnostics), never in the dashboard's drawer; Up from Rebuild goes back to the tabs. OK on Rebuild keeps the focus on Rebuild while the build runs and after it, and Down then stays in the page. Then the desktop layout: Enter on Rebuild keeps the keyboard's focus there too. Changes only the plugin's in-memory index (two rebuilds).

steps.name: an index to show: built once if the server has none yet
steps.eval: (async () => { const api = async (method, path) => { const r = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(path), { method, headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"', Accept: 'application/json' } }); return { status: r.status, body: r.status === 204 ? null : await r.json() }; }; let index = (await api('GET', 'LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index')).body; if (!index.Version) { await api('POST', 'LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index/Rebuild'); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && (!index.Version || index.Rebuilding); i++) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); index = (await api('GET', 'LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index')).body; } } return { version: index.Version, movies: index.Movies }; })()

steps.name: helpers
steps.script:
window.__lmtv = {
  page: () => document.querySelector('#LibraryMaintenanceConfigPage:not(.hide)'),
  q: (s) => (__lmtv.page() || document).querySelector(s),
  status: () => (__lmtv.q('#LibraryMaintenanceDuplicatesStatus') || {}).textContent || '',
  rebuild: () => __lmtv.q('#LibraryMaintenanceDuplicatesRebuild'),
  off: () => { const b = __lmtv.rebuild(); return !b || b.disabled || b.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true'; },
  selected: () => [...(__lmtv.page() || document).querySelectorAll('[role=tab][aria-selected=true]')].map(t => t.getAttribute('data-tab')),
  shown: (name) => { const p = __lmtv.q('#LibraryMaintenancePanel' + name); return !!p && !p.hasAttribute('hidden'); },
  focusOn: (selector) => { const e = __lmtv.q(selector); if (!e) { return false; } e.focus(); return document.activeElement === e; },
  where: () => { const a = document.activeElement; const r = a && a.getBoundingClientRect ? a.getBoundingClientRect() : null; const panel = a && a.closest ? a.closest('[role=tabpanel]') : null; return { id: (a && a.id) || null, tag: a ? a.tagName : null, text: a ? (a.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 30) : null, body: !a || a === document.body, inApp: !!(a && a.closest && a.closest('.jflm-page-app')), panel: panel ? panel.id.replace('LibraryMaintenancePanel', '') : null, rect: r ? [Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.top), Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)] : null, off: __lmtv.off() }; },
  index: async () => (await (await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index'), { headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"', Accept: 'application/json' } })).json()),
  posts: () => performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e => e.name.indexOf('/Duplicates/Index/Rebuild') >= 0).length
};
return true;
